typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight

auth_page.left_section: 60% width - High-impact AI Video Showcase with floating revenue metrics card, interactive playback controls, revenue highlights, and subtle animated ambient green/blue background glow
auth_page.right_section: 40% width - Centered interactive elevated Shadow Box Card (#FFFFFF) holding Auth/Signup/OTP dialog/Geofence state with smooth tab toggle
auth_page.footer: Sticky/Fixed legal compliance footer with text 'Created by SystemNex Techsolutions LLP. All rights reserved. TM Number: 7810892'

topbar.background: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 z-40 sticky top-0
topbar.content: Logo (Casafeast house-leaf icon in cream container), Chef Quick Info (Name, Email, Phone, Verification Badge), Quick Stats (Active Kitchen Indicator), Notification Bell with dot, Profile Avatar dropdown

sidebar.background: bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 border-r border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] sticky top-16

modes.onboarding_mode: Shows restricted navigation: Step Progress indicator, Lock Icons on deactivated modules, Guidelines & FAQ link
modes.activated_mode: Shows full dashboard nav: Overview, Onboarding Status, Menu Catalog, Orders Kanban, Revenue & Payouts, Kitchen Settings

sidebar.footer_widget: Sidebar Support Ticket Box (#1E293B bg, rounded-xl p-4, quick button 'Raise Support Ticket' with pulse indicator)

module_1_auth_geofence.sign_up_form: Name, Mobile Number (+91 format), Email, Kitchen Operating City selection
module_1_auth_geofence.otp_dialog: 6-digit segmented OTP input box with auto-focus, resend timer countdown (60s), and 'Verify OTP' button
module_1_auth_geofence.returning_login: Quick login with phone + OTP or credentials with 'Remember Me'
module_1_auth_geofence.geofence_lock: Visual map lock overlay showing chef's current geolocation vs Casafeast serviceable zones with radius status badge

modules_breakdown.module_2_workspace_shell: Top bar with live kitchen toggle (Online/Offline), notifications popover, chef user details card, support widget

steps: Step 1: Pre-Screening & Commercial Disclosure with prominent 20% Base + 18% GST Commission structure banner with clear payout calculation example card
Step 2: Personal Profile & KYC with drag-and-drop file uploaders for PAN Card & Aadhaar Front/Back with live preview badges
Step 3: FSSAI Compliance with 14-digit FSSAI License input, registration type, and certificate document upload
Step 4: Bank Account & Payout Details with IFSC verification lookup, account number confirmation, and cancelled cheque upload
module_3_onboarding_wizard.verification_progress_board: Real-time verification status board for 3 pillars: KYC Check (Verified/Pending), Bank Account Penny Drop (Verified/Pending), Field Hygiene Inspection (Scheduled/Verified) with progress ring

module_4_menu_catalog.create_menu_form: Dish Title, Cuisine Type dropdown, Category (Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner), Duration/Package builder (Single meal, Weekly Plan, Monthly Subscription), Veg/Non-Veg toggle, Packaging type, Pricing & Commission preview calculator
module_4_menu_catalog.catalog_view: Active vs Inactive Tabbed Grids, Search bar, Category filters, Rich Menu Cards with dish image, price tag, prep time badge, daily capacity counter, and toggle status switch

module_5_orders_kanban_and_revenue.orders_kanban: Columns for 'New / Today', 'Preparing / Upcoming', 'Dispatched / Completed'. Features live countdown timer per order, item checklist, bump status button, driver allocation detail
module_5_orders_kanban_and_revenue.revenue_analytics: KPI summary cards (Total Revenue, Net Payouts, Commission Paid, Total Orders Completed), Interactive Area Chart for daily/weekly revenue trends, Payout History table with downloadable PDF receipts

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft layered elevation (shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for floating auth form, shadow-xl for modals)
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp slate borders (border-slate-200) with rounded-xl or rounded-2xl radii
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/40 for floating widgets and topbar
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth scale-102 hover states on menu cards, status indicator pulses (animate-pulse green dot), transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color scheme: Crisp pure white canvas (#FFFFFF / #F8FAFC) accented with Dynamic Blue (#1D4ED8) for action elements and Organic Green (#15803D) for fresh/brand elements.
Implement the brand mark accurately: Green house-leaf mark inside a cream background box (#FDFBF7) with tagline 'Home-cooked. Planet-friendly.'

Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, status badges, dropdowns) contain comprehensive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='signup-submit-button', data-testid='otp-input-1').
Build the split-screen auth cleanly with a 60% left section hosting the video showcase shadow box and a 40% right section hosting the auth floating card.
Include the exact legal compliance footer at the bottom of the auth screen and dashboard shell: 'Created by SystemNex Techsolutions LLP. All rights reserved. TM Number: 7810892'.
Ensure the sidebar supports both 'onboarding_mode' (lock icons on unverified pages) and 'activated_mode' (full navigation enabled).
Implement the 4-step onboarding wizard with progress tracker, drag-and-drop file upload UI, 20%+18% GST commission breakdown, and verification progress board.
Provide clear interactive states for Orders Kanban (Today/Upcoming/Completed) and Revenue Analytics with interactive charts.
